description: Check live partner-specific registration availability and price, or renewal/transfer price and bounded eligibility evidence, for one or more named domains without writing cache rows. Choose order_type by the customer intent: Domain_Order buys a new domain; Domain_Renewal extends a registration; Domain_Transfer means transfer IN to EnCirca, never transfer out. Keep each price, term, status, and warning attached to its domain. A quote or unverified eligibility warning is not approval, payment, or a completed action. Public registry expiration is not a renewal quote.

domain_years.description: Optional per-domain registration period in years.

partner_id.description: Optional registration partner id; defaults to the configured MCP partner. Renewal and transfer always use their configured dedicated partners.

requirement_use_case.description: Restricted-TLD flow id when a TLD has multiple eligibility paths, e.g. preapproved or approval-help.

years.description: Registration period in years for all requested domains. Defaults to 1.

name: check_domain_price

eligibility.description: Read-only renewal eligibility evidence, when checked.

warning.description: Do not present an unverified renewal as approved.
